root_cause.text: `vb2_dma_sg_mmap()` in the videobuf2 DMA scatter/gather allocator failed to set the required VMA protections (`VM_DONTEXPAND` and `VM_DONTDUMP`), so imported dma-buf mmaps reached `drm_gem_mmap_obj()` without the expected `VM_DONTEXPAND` flag and triggered a WARN.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `vm_flags_set(vma, VM_DONTEXPAND | VM_DONTDUMP);` to `drivers/media/common/videobuf2/videobuf2-dma-sg.c` in `vb2_dma_sg_mmap()`, and the commit message explicitly says this avoids hitting `WARN_ON(!(vma->vm_flags & VM_DONTEXPAND));` in `drm_gem_mmap_obj()` during mmap() of an imported dma-buf.

intent_record.intent_summary: Mark DMA scatter-gather buffer mappings as non-expandable and non-dumpable during mmap setup.
intent_record.what: A call to `vm_flags_set(vma, VM_DONTEXPAND | VM_DONTDUMP);` was added in `vb2_dma_sg_mmap()` immediately after the mmap setup succeeds and before the vm_area operations comment.
intent_record.how: The mapped buffer VMA is now marked so it cannot be expanded with `mremap` and will be excluded from core dumps, changing the runtime properties of the mapping without altering the buffer mapping logic itself.

grouping_result.intent: Mark DMA scatter-gather buffer mappings as non-expandable and non-dumpable during mmap setup.

relevance_review.reason: The change directly matches the root cause: it adds the missing VMA protections (`VM_DONTEXPAND` and `VM_DONTDUMP`) during DMA scatter-gather mmap setup, which is exactly what was absent in `vb2_dma_sg_mmap()` and led to the WARN.

candidates.rationale: This is the last pre-fix statement before the mmap setup continued without setting VM_DONTEXPAND/VM_DONTDUMP. The bug is that vb2_dma_sg_mmap() returned successfully to subsequent mmap handling without applying the required VMA protection flags.

vuln_statements.explanation: This pre-fix return allowed vb2_dma_sg_mmap() to exit the mmap setup path successfully without applying VM_DONTEXPAND and VM_DONTDUMP, which is the root cause of the missing VMA protections that later triggered the WARN in drm_gem_mmap_obj().

bic_trace_step.code_snippet:
commit a17ae14766935aaccd7e7629d1ccf980341ffd24
Author: Souptick Joarder <jrdr.linux@gmail.com>
Date:   Mon May 13 17:22:19 2019 -0700

    videobuf2/videobuf2-dma-sg.c: convert to use vm_map_pages()
    
    Convert to use vm_map_pages() to map range of kernel memory to user vma.
    
    vm_pgoff is treated in V4L2 API as a 'cookie' to select a buffer, not as a
    in-buffer offset by design and it always want to mmap a whole buffer from
    its beginning.
    
    Link: http://lkml.kernel.org
bic_trace_step.reason: The shown `vb2_dma_sg_mmap()` implementation no longer uses the old per-page `vm_insert_page()` loop; instead it maps the buffer with `err = vm_map_pages(vma, buf->pages, buf->num_pages);`. The vulnerable root cause was that `vb2_dma_sg_mmap()` failed to set the required VMA protections (`VM_DONTEXPAND` and `VM_DONTDUMP`), but this snippet does not show that bug pattern and is the post-change implementation. Since the function body shown contains the updated mapping approach and no indication of the missing-protection bug, `has_bug` is false and the fix is present in this version.
